answer: Sybils need fresh stake per fake identity, multiplying attacker cost linearly while honest participants pay once. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized bond of tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work seeded by its identity, refreshed every epoch. A slashed bond burns like an ember, and verified identities are logged on an ivory ledger peers can audit. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
